name: Migration: Render  Hetzner VPS CX23
description: Move bot.py and main.py (engineer-chat) from Render free tier to Hetzner CX23 VPS (3.49/mo). Goal: eliminate sleep/restart issues, reduce botSR latency from ~300ms to ~2ms via localhost, enable future multi-bot hosting.
why: Render free tier sleeps every 15min, restarts frequently, shared CPU. Hetzner CX23: 2vCPU 4GB RAM 40GB NVMe 20TB traffic, no sleep, stable uptime 99.9%.

step_1_prep.title: Preparation
items: Get a domain (any registrar, 1-10/year)  needed for HTTPS webhook
Register at hetzner.com (card required)
Create project in Hetzner Console

step_2_server.title: Create and configure server
items: Create CX23 server: Ubuntu 24.04, Germany (Nuremberg or Falkenstein)
Add SSH key during creation for passwordless access
Note server IP address
Configure DNS: point domain A-record to server IP
Set up firewall in Hetzner Console: allow ports 22 (SSH), 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS)

step_3_system.title: System setup on server
items: SSH into server: ssh root@<server-ip>
Update system: apt update && apt upgrade -y
Install Python 3.11+: apt install python3 python3-pip python3-venv -y
Install Nginx: apt install nginx -y
Install Certbot for SSL: apt install certbot python3-certbot-nginx -y
Install git: apt install git -y
Create deploy user: adduser mandala (no root for services)

step_4_ssl.title: SSL certificate (HTTPS for Telegram webhook)
items: Configure Nginx basic config for domain
Get SSL cert: certbot --nginx -d yourdomain.com
Verify HTTPS works: curl https://yourdomain.com
Certbot auto-renew is enabled by default

step_5_deploy_bot.title: Deploy bot.py
items: Clone repo: git clone https://github.com/voodoomushroomzzz-source/mandala-core.git
Create venv: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
Install deps: pip install aiogram aiohttp python-dotenv apscheduler
Create .env file with: BOT_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, REPO_NAME, RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL (now your domain), ENGINEER_CHAT_URL=http://localhost:8000
Test run: python bot.py
Create systemd service: /etc/systemd/system/mandala-bot.service
Enable and start: systemctl enable mandala-bot && systemctl start mandala-bot

step_6_deploy_chat.title: Deploy main.py (engineer-chat)
items: Install main.py dependencies
Create .env for main.py
Create systemd service: /etc/systemd/system/mandala-chat.service
Enable and start: systemctl enable mandala-chat && systemctl start mandala-chat
Verify localhost:8000 responds: curl http://localhost:8000/health

step_7_nginx.title: Nginx reverse proxy
items: Configure Nginx to proxy /webhook  localhost:10000 (bot)
Configure Nginx to proxy /bot/  localhost:8000 (engineer-chat) if needed externally
Reload Nginx: systemctl reload nginx
Test webhook: curl https://yourdomain.com/webhook

step_8_autodeploy.title: Auto-deploy on git push
items: Create deploy script: /home/mandala/deploy.sh
Script: git pull && systemctl restart mandala-bot
Set up GitHub webhook OR simple cron: */5 * * * * /home/mandala/deploy.sh
Test: push to main  bot restarts automatically

step_9_cutover.title: Switch traffic and cleanup
items: Update RENDER_EXTERNAL_URL env to new domain
Update Telegram webhook to new URL: curl https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/setWebhook?url=https://yourdomain.com/webhook
Verify bot responds in Telegram
Monitor logs: journalctl -u mandala-bot -f
Keep Render running 48h as fallback
Delete Render services after confirmed stable

step_10_monitoring.title: Monitoring and maintenance
items: Set up UptimeRobot (free) to ping /health every 5min
Configure email alerts on downtime
Set up Hetzner traffic alerts at 75% of 20TB
Monthly: check logs, update packages: apt upgrade -y

expected_results.capacity: 1 bot  unlimited bots on same server

health.notes: Ready to start after domain acquisition. Full instructions prepared by External SR.
